description: Defines classes and types for managing QPACK header tables in QUIC, including base, encoder, and decoder classes, with focus on dynamic and static table management, header lookup, and observer notification.

classes.name: QpackHeaderTableBase
classes.description: Base class template for managing static and dynamic QPACK header tables, providing insertion, capacity management, and eviction functionalities.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Derived class for managing the encoder's QPACK header table, including header lookup and size management.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Derived class for managing the decoder's QPACK header table, including entry lookup and observer notification for insert count thresholds.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable::Observer
classes.description: Interface for observers to receive notifications when insert count thresholds are reached in the decoder header table.

methods.name: EntryFitsDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Checks if an entry with given name and value fits within the dynamic table capacity.

methods.name: InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header (name, value) into the dynamic table, possibly evicting entries, and returns the absolute index.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the dynamic table, evicting entries if necessary.

methods.name: SetMaximumDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed capacity for the dynamic table, only once.

methods.name: RemoveEntryFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the oldest entry from the end of the dynamic table.

methods.name: EvictDownToCapacity
methods.description: Evicts entries until the table size is within the specified capacity.

methods.name: FindHeaderField
methods.description: Finds header entries matching name and value, returning match type and index.

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates maximum size of an entry that can be inserted without eviction.

methods.name: draining_index
methods.description: Calculates the draining index to avoid blocked insertions based on draining fraction.

methods.name: LookupEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a header entry by static/dynamic index.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for insert count threshold notifications.
